subject: CloudForge SDK: request to pin SDK minor version + hotfix plan
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex@cloudforge.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: pin minor SDK version (v2.4.x) + short-term hotfix window

Hi Vivek / Marcus —

Quick context: CloudForge bundles Redwood’s SDK in our connector that is shipped to ~120 enterprise customers. We just discovered that a minor release (v2.5.0) of the SDK introduced a default JSON-encoding change that breaks our CI for large embedding payloads. The change is backward-incompatible for our customers using on-prem deploys.

We need two things from Redwood:
- A short-term option to pin to v2.4.x for our connectors hosted in marketplace and a semantic guarantee for a 90-day window
- A hotfix (or patch release) that restores the previous encoding behavior or exposes a runtime flag to opt out

We can attach a minimal failing test and a diff; attaching the failing unit here (cloudforge_sdk_patch.diff) and a draft mutual action plan that maps steps to dates (cloudforge_mutual_action_plan.xlsx).

Can you confirm feasibility and an ETA for a patch? We’re prepared to coordinate a joint release window and push a coordinated notice to affected customers.

Thanks —
Alex Mercer
Head of Integrations, CloudForge
alex@cloudforge.ai

---
Attachment: cloudforge_sdk_patch.diff (text/diff, 4KB)
From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex@cloudforge.ai>, Priya Saini <priya@cloudforge.ai>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 30 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pin minor SDK version (v2.4.x) + short-term hotfix window

Alex —

Thanks for the heads-up and the repro. I’ve looped in Marcus (runtime/kernel team) and Vanessa (partner operations) so we can triage and get you a plan ASAP. Initial ask is reasonable — we prefer to avoid breaking changes in minor bumps but need to validate the surface area.

Quick questions to help scope:
- Is the failing test specific to the embedding batching path or also affects streaming/generation? (you mentioned large embedding payloads)
- Do you require a semver pin on hosted clients only (marketplace images) or across public SDK releases?

I’ll sync with Marcus and follow up with an ETA today. Vanessa — can your team draft the partner comms cadence if we commit to a 90-day pin?

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Alliances, Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.ai

From: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Alex Mercer <alex@cloudforge.ai>, Priya Saini <priya@cloudforge.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pin minor SDK version (v2.4.x) + short-term hotfix window

Thanks for the repro and diff, Alex — I dug in with the runtime team this morning. Summary of findings and proposal: 

Findings:
- The behavior change lives in the payload serialization helper used by the embedding batcher; it was replaced with a stricter JSON encoder to close a security surface. The change is small but affects certain payload shapes (arrays > 8k tokens) which CloudForge hits.
- We can revert to the previous encoder behavior for the minor line (v2.5.1 patch) or alternatively add a runtime flag REDWOOD_LEGACY_ENCODER=true to preserve old behavior.

Proposal (recommended):
1) Ship v2.5.1 as a patch that reintroduces a legacy-compat path behind an opt-in runtime flag.
2) Offer a temporary marketplace/staging image pinned to v2.4.x for 90 days — we will mark it as deprecated at 60 days with a migration checklist.
3) Provide a small compatibility shim (attached diff) that CloudForge can apply to their connector until their customers update (3 lines, trivial).
4) Joint comms: Redwood issues a security/compatibility advisory and CloudForge sends a customer note. Vanessa/Olga — I’ve attached a proposed MAP spreadsheet and a short draft note for customers.

ETA: we can cut a branch today, patch build by EOD tomorrow (2026-09-01), and coordinated release + comms on 2026-09-03 if that timeline works for your ops.

Next steps:
- Alex/Priya: confirm you can test the shim + the patch on your staging by 2026-09-02
- Vanessa: please prepare the partner comms and the marketplace pin image task (I’ll create the release PR)

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Senior Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
marcus@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: cloudforge_mutual_action_plan.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 12KB)
Attachment: cloudforge_sdk_patch.diff (text/diff, 4KB)
From: Priya Saini <priya@cloudforge.ai>
To: marcus_lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Mercer <alex@cloudforge.ai>, vanessa_ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, olga_petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 16:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: pin minor SDK version (v2.4.x) + short-term hotfix window

Marcus / Vivek —

This plan looks good and the timeline is acceptable. We ran the shim locally and it resolves the failing unit; we’ll run full integration next morning (2026-09-01). Confirming CloudForge will:
- Test patch v2.5.1 in staging on 2026-09-01
- Accept the 90-day pin for marketplace images with the 60-day deprecation notice
- Co-author the joint customer advisory once Redwood drafts the security/compatibility advisory

We appreciate the quick turnaround. Please add me to the release PR and the HubSpot deal (HUBSPOT-67890) so we can track comms.

Best,
Priya Saini
Director, Platform Integrations, CloudForge
priya@cloudforge.ai
